source_text: Nosti o Maria, quae Patriarchas et prophetas latebant. Didicisti, o Virgo, quae adhuc Angelis etiam fuerunt abscondita. Audisti, o sanctissima, quae nunquam, divino spiritu afflatorum chorus audire meruit. Moyses et David, Esaias ac Daniel, cunctique prophetae de ipso praedicaverunt: sed modum rationemve ignorarunt. Tu vero sola, o sanctissima Virgo, quae his omnibus ignota fuerunt mysteria, nunc suscipis, causamque intelligis. Nam ubi Spiritus Sanctus, cuncta prompte atque incunctanter perficiuntur. Ubi divina adest gratia, omnia Deo sunt possibilia.
thought_title: Mary alone learns what prophets never knew
orientation: Gabriel is still answering Mary after telling her the Holy Spirit will come upon her.
pass_a_gloss: You know, O Mary, the things which lay hidden from the Patriarchs and prophets. You have learned, O Virgin, the things which have been hidden until now even from angels. You have heard, O most holy one, the things which the chorus of those breathed upon by divine spirit never merited to hear. Moses and David, Isaiah and Daniel, and all the prophets preached concerning him: but they did not know the manner or the reason. But you alone, O most holy Virgin, now receive the mysteries which were unknown to all these, and you understand the cause. For where the Holy Spirit is, all things are accomplished promptly and without hesitation. Where divine grace is present, all things are possible to God.

pass_b_english: Mary, you know what lay hidden from the patriarchs and prophets. Virgin, you have learned what remained hidden even from the angels. Most holy one, you have heard what the chorus of those breathed upon by the divine Spirit never merited to hear. Moses and David, Isaiah and Daniel, and all the prophets proclaimed him, yet they did not know the manner or the reason.

But you alone, most holy Virgin, now receive the mysteries unknown to all of them, and you understand their cause. For where the Holy Spirit is, everything is accomplished swiftly and without hesitation. Where divine grace is present, all things are possible with God.
